_comment: Controlled vocabulary for the System Journal distiller. distill.py loads this from <vault>/scripts/system-journal/vocab.json; when it is absent, distill.py falls back to its own built-in generic default. This file ships the same generic default so a fresh vault starts with a sensible list. systems = the controlled `systems` tag list (the distiller must pick from it, plus client:<slug>); sensitive_tags = tags that drop a whole line from the audit tier; sensitive_path_prefixes = vault-relative path prefixes that also drop a line. Extend deliberately for your own vault; every sensitive tag that matters should also appear in systems.
